scenario: Optional shared commercial loop plus real OpenCode context transport and independent native Pi source audit

review.reason: No concrete reproducible defect found in the supplied source. The optional commercial loop preserves free-form research, adds independent alignment gates, keeps old-loop behavior when disabled, enforces handoff stop confirmation, persists alignment/handoff evidence, constrains benchmark fetching, and prevents candidate acceptance unless Host tests, mandatory reviews, protected paths, and commercial verification pass.
evidence: runtime/adapters.mjs: decodeAnswer(..., 'text') preserves prose without JSON parsing; promptFor switches text vs JSON contracts.

runtime/commercial.mjs: CommercialLoop.stage writes analysis.md/context/alignment records, validates independent audit shape, blocks PASS without verified benchmark text, and snapshots before/after to reject source mutation.
runtime/project.mjs: alignment gates are inserted for observe, plan, execution-route, verify, and commercial-completion; verify outcome participates in merge acceptance.

runtime/project.mjs: executeWithHandoff only resumes after execute() has disposed the failed run; STOP_UNCONFIRMED is not handed off; builderHistory/builderIdentities are updated for review exclusion.
runtime/project.mjs: commercial mode is optional; old execute/select/review path remains used when config.commercialLoop.enabled is false.
runtime/research.mjs: readBenchmark requires public HTTPS, rejects credentials/query/non-public DNS, pins DNS lookup, disables redirects, and enforces 15s/512KB budgets.

tests/commercial-loop.test.mjs: covers free-form prose, quota handoff preservation, contributor exclusion, plan/verify/completion gates, public address rejection, and commercial audit blocking acceptance.

findings.description: Acceptance limitation: the commercial loop relies on configured references or an injected Host researcher; it does not itself provide autonomous full-web search or vision browsing. This matches the stated design, not a bug.
Acceptance limitation: configured Host test executables and configured references are trusted local configuration, so malicious local configuration remains out of scope.

quotaHandoff.scope: Partial files preserved; stop confirmed before takeover; all contributors excluded from reviews. No claim of native quota rollover in this pilot.
